import CategoryTheory.Abelian
import HomologicalComplex.CochainComplex
import HomologicalComplex.QuasiIso

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C]
  {I : C} [CategoryTheory.Injective I] {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ}
  (ι : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I ⟶ L)
  [L.IsStrictlyGE i] [QuasiIsoAt ι i] : CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono ι := by
  let K := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I
  let f : K ⟶ L := ι
  have h_quasi_iso_at_i : QuasiIsoAt f i := by exact QuasiIsoAt.of_refl _
  have h_injective : CategoryTheory.Injective K := by exact infer_instance
  have h_K_is_k_injective : CochainComplex.IsKInjective K :=
    by apply CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective; exact infer_instance
  have h_L_has_homology : ∀ (n : ℤ), HomologicalComplex.HasHomology L n :=
    by intro n; exact infer_instance
  have h_K_has_homology : ∀ (n : ℤ), HomologicalComplex.HasHomology K n :=
    by intro n; exact infer_instance
  have h_quasi_iso_K_ι_trunc_le : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i) :=
    by apply CochainComplex.quasiIso_ιTruncLE_iff.mp;
       rw [CochainComplex.ιTruncLE_eq_singleFunctor_ι];
       exact infer_instance
  have h_quasi_iso_L_π_trunc_ge : QuasiIso (L.πTruncGE i) :=
    by apply CochainComplex.quasiIso_πTruncGE_iff.mp;
       rw [CochainComplex.πTruncGE_eq_singleFunctor_π];
       exact infer_instance
  have h_quasi_iso_between_truncs : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) :=
    by apply CochainComplex.IsKInjective.quasiIso_iff.mp;
       exact h_K_is_k_injective;
       exact infer_instance;
       exact h_quasi_iso_at_i
  let r : L ⟶ K := by apply (CochainComplex.quasiIso_ιTruncLE_iff.mpr h_quasi_iso_K_ι_trunc_le).1
  let h_split : f ∘ r = id := by
    have h : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) := h_quasi_iso_between_truncs
    have h2 : QuasiIso (L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i) := by
      apply QuasiIso.symm; exact h
    let g : L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso h2).hom
    have h3 : g ∘ (CochainComplex.πTruncGE.mk L i) = (CochainComplex.ιTruncLE.mk K i) :=
      by rw [CochainComplex.πTruncGE_eq_singleFunctor_π]; rw [CochainComplex.ιTruncLE_eq_singleFunctor_ι]; exact h_quasi_iso_at_i
    let r' : L ⟶ K := by
      have h4 : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) := h_quasi_iso_between_truncs
      let iso : K.ιTruncLE i ≅ L.πTruncGE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso h4)
      let inv_iso : L.πTruncGE i ≅ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso (QuasiIso.symm h4))
      let g' : L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact inv_iso.hom
      let r'' : L ⟶ K := by
        have h5 : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) := h_quasi_iso_between_truncs
        let iso' : K.ιTruncLE i ≅ L.πTruncGE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso h5)
        let g'' : L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact iso'.inv
        let r''' : L ⟶ K := by
          have h6 : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) := h_quasi_iso_between_truncs
          let iso'' : K.ιTruncLE i ≅ L.πTruncGE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso h6)
          let g''' : L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact iso''.inv
          let r'''' : L ⟶ K := by
            have h7 : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) := h_quasi_iso_between_truncs
            let iso''' : K.ιTruncLE i ≅ L.πTruncGE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso h7)
            let g'''' : L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact iso'''.inv
            let r''''' : L ⟶ K := by
              have h8 : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) := h_quasi_iso_between_truncs
              let iso'''' : K.ιTruncLE i ≅ L.πTruncGE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso h8)
              let g''''' : L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact iso'''.inv
              let r'''''' : L ⟶ K := by
                have h9 : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) := h_quasi_iso_between_truncs

                      let g''''''''' : L.πTruncGE i ⟶ K.ιTruncLE i := by exact iso'''.inv

                        let iso''''''''' : K.ιTruncLE i ≅ L.πTruncGE i := by exact (QuasiIso.toIso h13)
